防衛機構に操られたリオラの盾を越え、炉を止める。今度こそ、失うのが怖いという理由: You must break through Liora’s shield, seized by the defense system, and halt the furnace. Fear of losing her cannot delay you again.

温室から離れても、あの声が耳に残る。セリスは何も尋ねず、地下墓所への灯を持った。: Away from the greenhouse, that voice still follows you. Seris asks nothing and carries a lamp toward the crypt.

拾った紙には、封印を解く代償が残っていた。止めていた滅びも、動き出す。: A scrap names the price of ending the seal: the ruin it held back will move again.
灰の中でノエルの筆跡を探す。答えを知れば、救えるという保証はない。: You search the ashes for Noelle’s handwriting. Knowing the answer promises no rescue.
計算は一人の犠牲を必要としていた。余白に、別の手で「本当に？」と書かれている。: The calculation demands one sacrifice. In another hand, the margin asks: Must it?
一通だけ燃え残った手紙に、四人の名が並んでいた。: One surviving letter lists four names.
「ひとりに返さない」。書き手は、答えより先に約束を残した。: “We will not leave it to one person.” The writer left a promise before finding an answer.
止まった振子を越えるたび、温室で扉を叩かなかった夜を思い出す。: Crossing the stopped pendulum, you remember the night you did not knock on the greenhouse door.
時間を戻す装置ではなかった。振子は、止めた時間の重さを測っている。: It is no machine for turning back time. It measures the weight of time held still.
空に星はない。それでもノエルは、観測をやめていなかった。: There are no stars. Noelle has kept observing anyway.
星が消えたのではない。街の夜だけが、空から切り離されている。: The stars are not gone. The city’s night has been severed from the sky.
星図の消えた部分に、仲間の名を書き直す。: You write your companions’ names onto the erased portions of the chart.
四つの名が消えずに残った。独りで支えるための式が、初めて崩れる。: Four names remain. The formula that required one person to bear everything finally breaks.
ノエルが星図を抱えて道を塞ぐ。希望だけで封印を解くなら、ここは通せないという。: Noelle bars the way with her chart. Hope alone is no reason to break the seal.
危険を引き受ける名を、全員が自分で書いた。彼女はようやく、鍵を差し出す。: Each of you writes your own name to accept the risk. At last, she offers the key.

遠くの療養室にも、薄い光が入った。彼女があなたを思い出したという知らせは、来ない: A little light reaches the distant care room. No word comes that she remembers you.
リゼットが最後の道で待つ。「失う覚悟と、誰かを見捨てることを混同しないで」: Lisette waits on the final path. “Do not confuse accepting loss with abandoning someone.”
セリスは剣を抜く。正しい結末を貰うためではなく、選んだ明日を引き受けるために。: Seris draws her sword, to accept the tomorrow she chooses rather than earn a perfect ending.
弔鐘の剣姫を越え、街の朝を解き放つ。誰か一人を代償にはしない。: You face the swordswoman of the mourning bell and release the city’s morning. No one person will pay its price.
街に朝が来る。温室の椅子は空のままだった。あなたは茶碗を洗い、今日は扉を叩く。返: Morning reaches the city. The greenhouse chair remains empty. You wash the cups. Today you knock, to let her know you are there, even if no answer comes.
恋と、まだ生まれない命。戻せない記憶の物語。: Love, a life yet to be born, and memories that cannot return.
盾が、もう私の命令を聞かない……今のうちに、止めろ。: My shield no longer obeys me... Stop it while you can.
まだ意識はある。迷うな、炉へ行け！: I am still here. Do not hesitate. Get to the furnace!
朝の来ない街に着いた。: You arrive in a city without morning.
鳴らない鐘の下で、古い地図を拾う。: Beneath a silent bell, you find a map with its fountain scratched out.
月の蛾が、閉じた花の上を渡る。: Moon moths drift above closed flowers.
水路を塞ぐ根を外す。: You clear roots from the channel.
泉へ続く橋が身じろぎする。: The bridge to the spring stirred.
水面に大きな影が浮く。: A vast shadow rises beneath the water.
雨の日、あなたは食事を届ける。: On a rainy day, you bring a meal.
棚に二つ目の茶碗が置かれる。: A second teacup appears on the shelf.
中庭の荊をほどきながら、二人は恋人としての最初の約束をする。: Untangling the courtyard thorns, you make your first promise as lovers: say when something is too much.
古い設計図が見つかる。: You discover plans for an incubator that can grow a new individual, with a will of its own, from two people’s memories.
核は声に反応する。: The core answers voices but repeats the same greeting.
診療室で、記憶の欠落は培養炉の負荷だと告げられる。: At the clinic, you learn the missing memories are caused by the incubator’s strain.
培養槽があなたの声で彼女を呼ぶ。: The vessel calls to her in your voice.

"We can build a place to return to together." Even wounded, her hand never falters before the next strike.
水辺の朽ちた社で、誰も忘れた歌を琵琶に託す女神。ひとつの音が波紋になるたび、離れ: In a weathered waterside shrine, she entrusts forgotten songs to her biwa. Each note sends ripples of comfort to distant, wounded hearts. She prefers a quiet night beside weary travelers to a splendid feast, and stays until the final note fades.
長い水色の髪を夜風にほどき、滝から滝へ祈りを運ぶ女神。簡素な旅衣と銀の水鉢だけを: Her long blue hair catches the night breeze as she carries prayers between waterfalls. With simple traveling robes and a silver water bowl, she washes away her companions' ailments. She never tells them what awaits beyond the bridge, but walks beside them until they cross.
織りかけの朝を小さな糸巻きに収め、廃都を歩く女神。いつもの生成りの旅衣には、仲間: She carries an unfinished dawn on a small spool as she walks the ruined city. Her plain traveling dress bears stitches lovingly repaired by companions. Each gentle knot reminds them that they can continue their journey without haste.
稲穂と小さな升を抱え、白狐と里の跡を巡る女神。普段の旅衣は土の色に近く、畦道に座: With rice stalks and a little wooden measure, she visits abandoned villages alongside a white fox. 祈りも、命乞いも、彼女の歯車を止めない。: Neither prayer nor pleading can halt her gears.
廃都の兵器工房で目を覚ました機巧少女。陶器の肌と氷色の瞳に、歓びも怒りも浮かばな: A clockwork maiden awakened in the ruined city’s weapons workshop. Neither joy nor anger crosses her porcelain face or icy eyes. 貨幣を打つ音の絶えた造幣堂で、運命の輪を見守る女神。彼女が量るのは金貨の輝きでは: In a mint long silent, she watches over the wheel of fortune. She weighs not the shine of a coin, but the journey taken to bring it home. When a traveler offers a worn purse, she smiles. "You carried your own good fortune all the way here." As the ancient wheel turns again, countless small prayers become a golden ward around her companions.
ゴールドを消費して、この女神を仲間に迎えます。一度限りの交換です。: Spend gold to welcome this goddess. This exchange is available once.
夜明けを失うことを恐れ、時計塔ごと時を閉ざした機巧の聖女。壊れた針を何度も繕う銀: Fearing the loss of dawn, this clockwork saint sealed time within her tower. Her silver fingers mend broken hands, though she no longer remembers whom her prayers were for. Deep among the gears, a tiny pendulum still awaits the morning. "If moving forward need not mean losing everything..." Beyond the shattered dial, she sees a sky of her own for the first time.
止まった針を、あなたの加速で砕け。: Break the frozen hands with your acceleration.
機巧の聖女クローナとの1Wave長期決戦。毎ターン固定値の障壁を再生し、破壊する: A single-wave endurance battle against Chrona, the clockwork saint. Her shield restores a fixed amount each turn; breaking it lowers her defense for the rest of that turn. From turn 20 she unleashes a devastating party-wide attack. Protect Eos as your leader and let acceleration outpace regeneration, or use barrier breaking and defense reduction. No materials, gold, or stones; only a clear record. Used potions are consumed.
ここでは、夜明けさえ刻を忘れる。: Even dawn forgets the passage of time here.

序章 ― 欲望の扉、その向こう: Prologue — Beyond the Gate of Desire
死にたがりの世界で、私はまだ息をしていた。: In a world longing for death, I was still breathing.
世界には、たったひとつの「欲望の扉」があった。\nその向こうでは、どんな願いも叶:
There was only one Gate of Desire in this world.
Beyond it, someone had said, any wish could come true.
愛されたい。取り戻したい。許されたい。\n数多の少女が、ひとつの扉へ手を伸ばした:
To be loved. To reclaim what was lost. To be forgiven.
Countless girls reached for that single door.
願いは、別の願いを押しのけた。\n少女たちは傷つけ合い、扉の前で、互いの明日を奪:
One wish pushed another aside.
The girls wounded each other, stealing one another's tomorrows before the gate.
私には、願うものなんてなかった。\nただ、この世界にいることが苦しかった。:
I had nothing left to wish for.
Simply existing in this world was painful.
それでも争いに巻き込まれ、手を伸ばす理由さえ見つけられないまま、私は扉の前に立っ: Yet I was swept into the struggle. Without even a reason to reach for it, I found myself standing before the gate.
やがて、声が途絶えた。\n皮肉なことに、生還したのは、何も望まなかった私ひとりだ:
